Next to it, a one-off working Leica BOX prototype, a Soviet lunar camera, a set of Lomo anamorphic cine lenses and the Leica R6 that Sebastião Salgado took to the burning oil fields of Kuwait go under the hammer. The auction starts at 12:00 pm CET at Am Leitz-Park in Wetzlar, and pre-bidding is already open in the online catalog of Auction 49 . You can bid in the room, live online at leitz-auction.com or through LiveAuctioneers (which adds a 5% fee plus VAT), by phone, or with an absentee bid. noticias.titulo: a review of midcentury kinetic environments: when artists turned entire rooms into moving machines
noticias.resumo: when motion became a property of space   Throughout the 1950s and 1960s, an international network of artists began to explore the possibilities of kinetic art at the scale of architecture. Motors and electrical circuits…
noticias.trecho: when motion became a property of space   Throughout the 1950s and 1960s, an international network of artists began to explore the possibilities of kinetic art at the scale of architecture. Motors and electrical circuits found their way into museum galleries, where entire interiors could be animated with moving structures and artificial light. In some cases, the machinery responded to the viewer’s presence.   An early precedent for these experiments came from the Bauhaus. In 1930, Hungarian artist László Moholy-Nagy introduced his Light Prop for an Electric Stage, also known as the Light-Space Modulator, at an exhibition in Paris. As the machine’s metal components rotated, light passed through perforated surfaces and bounced off reflective elements. Its movements generated a second composition across the surrounding walls. noticias.trecho: Fluent Format’s David Lewis on Pattern Coffee, the Belfast speciality coffee brand he’s built with Andile Cebekhulu as a side project, and what it taught them about clients. I’m a big fan of side projects. Creative Boom began as one, and look at it now. It seems I’m not alone. Every studio has one. The passionate thing on the side that gets talked about on a Friday afternoon, sketched out on paper, and then quietly forgotten about when Monday’s deadlines come in. David Lewis and Andile Cebekhulu actually made theirs come true. David is the founder and creative director of Belfast brand and digital consultancy Fluent Format; Andile is its lead developer. By day, the pair build brands and digital experiences for other people. Alongside all that, they’ve been finding the time to build Pattern Coffee, a speciality coffee brand of their own. referencias.trecho: As long as humans have been around, we’ve been curious about existential questions like, Why are we here? And how do things work? That goes for our own bodies, too. But in our era of modern science and medicine, it’s difficult to imagine a time when physicians weren’t familiar with all of the bones in the skeleton, how a baby grows inside a womb, or how the cardiovascular system works. Even the profession that comes to mind when we think of a doctor didn’t really emerge until the past few centuries. During the medieval period, barber-surgeons were the primary medical practitioners (yes, the people who cut hair also conducted surgeries). biblioteca.titulo: Explorando formas narrativas na arte indiana contemporânea: envolvendo o público por meio da narrativa interativa
biblioteca.resumo: Este artigo examina como as narrativas estruturais na arte indiana contemporânea promovem interação entre a arte e o seu público. Foram empregados métodos qualitativos, como entrevistas e observações, para analisar as…
biblioteca.trecho: Este artigo examina como as narrativas estruturais na arte indiana contemporânea promovem interação entre a arte e o seu público. Foram empregados métodos qualitativos, como entrevistas e observações, para analisar as técnicas de narração indianas e como estas aprofundam imersão e interação. Os resultados indicam que a arte narrativa expressa identidade cultural, aborda questões sociais e transmite experiências pessoais, promovendo, assim, a compreensão cultural e a consciência social. Outro aspecto observado é a recente transformação dos museus indianos, com meios híbridos e digitais na partilha do conhecimento cultural por aprendizagens imersivas baseadas na ciência. Este estudo mostra que tecnologia, narrativa e interação com o público podem, juntas, incentivar respostas emocionais, confiança e envolvimento comunitário na arte e cultura.

Yes, every Friday after Thanksgiving is known as Native American Heritage Day, along with the entire month of November being Native American Heritage Month.  In 2009, former President Barack Obama permanently designated the day to honor Native American and Alaska Native cultural heritage and tribal sovereignty, according to an archived press release from the U.S. Department of Interior. Regardless of what day or month it is, Native peoples are always wearing their moccasins in traditional and unfamiliar places, carrying the reminder that moccasins are gifted and worn with love.  My Mocs Miles Morrisseau ICT My moccasins are moosehide and rabbit fur and were made and beaded by elder Alice Cook, former chief of the Misipawistik Cree Nation…

bolhas.resumo: The Board of La Biennale di Venezia has appointed Hoor Al-Qasimi , president and director of the Sharjah Art Foundation (SAF), to curate the 62nd Venice Biennale in 2028. She will be the first Arab curator of the…
bolhas.trecho: The Board of La Biennale di Venezia has appointed Hoor Al-Qasimi , president and director of the Sharjah Art Foundation (SAF), to curate the 62nd Venice Biennale in 2028. She will be the first Arab curator of the international art exhibition. Al-Qasimi has been active in the international contemporary art world for over two decades. The Emirati curator has led major exhibitions such as the 2020 Lahore Biennale, the 2025 Aichi Triennale, and the 2026 Biennale of Sydney. She has led the Sharjah Biennial since 2003 and, in 2009, founded SAF, which supports contemporary art and cultural exchange in Sharjah and abroad. Since 2017, she has been president of the International Biennial Association. She is also president and director of the Sharjah Architecture Triennial, which was launched in 2019 by her late brother Khalid Al-Qasimi. Pietrangelo Buttafuoco, president of the Venice Biennale…

bolhas.resumo: In June 2026, Saudi Arabia’s Visual Arts Commission sent a delegation of artists and cultural practitioners to Spain as part of Art Bridges, a professional development program connecting participants with international…
bolhas.trecho: In June 2026, Saudi Arabia’s Visual Arts Commission sent a delegation of artists and cultural practitioners to Spain as part of Art Bridges, a professional development program connecting participants with international peers. Visits to Madrid’s cultural institutions and artists’ studios prompted discussions about artistic research, education’s role in curatorial practice, and the sustained support needed to develop ideas beyond immediate exhibition outcomes. Below, Maisa Shaldan, Sara AlBunayan, and Seema Alabdulhai reflect on the exchange and the possibilities it opened for Saudi Arabia’s growing visual arts sector. MAISA SHALDAN Maisa Shaldan is a Saudi visual artist of Palestinian origin whose practice explores memory, cultural heritage, and belonging through experimentation with natural materials.
